arguments.name: Industrial Carbon Twin — exploratory synthetic stakeholders
arguments.research_objective: Explore hypothetical stakeholder reactions to this illustrative decarbonization investment scenario and the usefulness of the Carbon Twin interface.
arguments.context:
Use the existing seven-question DRAFT survey. Do not publish, email real people, recruit humans, or change any engineering/financial assumptions.

Generate 12 AI-simulated respondents. Aim for a balanced mix of industrial plant managers, sustainability/ESG professionals, finance/investment analysts, environmental researchers, industrial engineers, and policy/regulatory analysts. Approximately two per perspective is a preference, not an unsupported hard quota; retain and report the actual generated composition.

Label every result AI-Simulated Respondents — Exploratory Research Only. Do not infer actual market demand or statistically representative industry preferences.

Return the job_id and, when available, actual answer data and question labels, role profiles, respondent completion statuses, distributions, concerns and limitations. Do not invent missing answers or segment assignments.
